title: Mynyra research lab
summary: A trading foundation you can inspect: deterministic, offline, and deliberately separated from live market operation.

pipeline.label: Run manifest
pipeline.detail: Pins executable, input, configuration, permissions, and resource limits before processing begins.

pipeline.label: Offline replay
pipeline.detail: Processes canonical local records deterministically without a provider, broker, credential, or network path.

pipeline.label: Evidence envelope
pipeline.detail: Returns a redacted result with the executable, input, and configuration hashes bound to the run.

signals.label: Execution mode
signals.detail: The first proof contract is a deterministic local replay.

signals.label: Provider access
signals.detail: No provider or broker connection is configured.

signals.label: Order capability
signals.detail: The offline manifest rejects order-enabled permissions.

signals.label: Product backend
signals.detail: The public control-room UI remains static and local-display only.

nextGate: Generate sanitized, commit-bound offline evidence without introducing a product backend.
